risk_note: CT-24zzo (contract only, tester none; D10-2105 / D10-2107). Adds two planned read-only admin operations for payout batches: listAdminPayoutBatches (GET /admin/v1/payout-batches) and getAdminPayoutBatch (GET /admin/v1/payout-batches/{batch_id}), with member schema AdminPayoutBatchMember. Members ordered by their first payout_batch_items time in the batch, then withdrawal_id; held_count and the held filter share one definition (member still on the batch, status APPROVED, hold_reason non-null); a member's hold_reason is null unless APPROVED; next_query_at only while channel_state is null or processing. The existing AdminWithdrawal schema and adminCreatePayoutBatch are unchanged. Generated files (openapi.gen.ts, planned-operations.gen.ts, auth / signing / min-version route tables) from codegen; after the rebase onto main (with #324) codegen produced no change, contracts:check and prettier exit 0.
